summary.text: Paul Dargie is a Democratic member of the New Hampshire House of Representatives from Hillsborough 43, where he assumed office on December 4, 2024, and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.
A technical manager in the printer products industry, he has also served on the Milford school board and select board.

paragraphs.text: Paul Dargie's career experience includes working as a technical manager in the printer products industry.
He has been affiliated with the Milford Lions Club and the Boy Scouts and has served on the Milford school board and select board.
Dargie previously served in the New Hampshire House of Representatives for Hillsborough 23 from 2018 to 2020, and his 2019-2020 committee assignment was the Municipal and County Government Committee.
